approved: Owner decisions 23 Oct 2026; exact text in claims-check/ACOUSTIC-CR-CORRECTION-BEFORE-AFTER.md

changes.before: The definitive independent double-blind placebo-controlled trial (Hall 2022, N=100) found no benefit over placebo.
changes.after: A double-blind placebo-controlled trial led by academic researchers (Hall 2022, N=100) found no benefit over placebo.

changes.before: The T30 CR device was cleared in 2011 under the masker regulation (874.3400) — clearance is not efficacy. A 2017 systematic review already called the evidence insufficient; the independent 2022 RCT was null. Current company status could not be verified.
changes.after: The T30 CR device was cleared in 2011 under the masker regulation (874.3400) — clearance is not efficacy. A 2017 systematic review already called the evidence insufficient; the academic-led 2022 RCT was null. Current company status could not be verified.

changes.before: Positive 2012 pilot — refuted by the independent 2022 placebo-controlled trial
changes.after: Positive 2012 pilot — not confirmed by the academic-led 2022 placebo-controlled trial

changes.before: Original program manufacturer-linked; the null 2022 trial was independent (NIHR Nottingham).
changes.after: Original program manufacturer-linked; the null 2022 trial was led by academic researchers (NIHR Nottingham) and part-funded by a grant from a UK tinnitus clinic, awarded in partnership with the device's manufacturer at the time; the funder had no role in study design, data collection, analysis, interpretation or writing of the report. This funding link does not establish that the manufacturer controlled the research.

changes.before: Independent double-blind placebo-controlled trial (Hall et al., N=100): no benefit over placebo.
changes.after: Academic-led double-blind placebo-controlled trial (Hall et al., N=100): no benefit over placebo.

after.change: Wording corrected: the 2022 placebo-controlled trial is now described as academic-led and part-funded through a grant made in partnership with the manufacturer, instead of 'independent'; 'refuted by' replaced with 'not confirmed by'.
after.reason: The trial's published funding statement (Brain Sci 2022, PMC8946033) reports a grant from a tinnitus clinic awarded in partnership with the device manufacturer, so 'independent' was inaccurate. Found during the Claims Check fact-check of 23 October 2026. The result (no benefit over placebo, p = 0.85), evidence score, tier, replication and independence ratings are unchanged.

changes.before: Original manufacturer-linked positive trials vs an independent null trial (2022).
changes.after: Original manufacturer-linked positive trials vs a null trial (2022) by a different, academic research group.

changes.before: The POSITIVE evidence is manufacturer-linked; the independent trial was null.
changes.after: The POSITIVE evidence is manufacturer-linked; the null trial was academic-led but part-funded through a grant made in partnership with the manufacturer.

changes.before: The definitive independent test of acoustic coordinated reset. An earlier industry-co-authored commentary (Front Psychol 2017) had called the RESET2 program 'non-conclusive'.
changes.after: The pivotal double-blind test of acoustic coordinated reset, led by academic researchers. An earlier industry-co-authored commentary (Front Psychol 2017) had called the RESET2 program 'non-conclusive'.

Academic-led (NIHR Nottingham Biomedical Research Centre); part-funded by a grant from a UK tinnitus clinic, awarded in partnership with the device's manufacturer at the time; the funder had no role in study design, data collection, analysis, interpretation or writing of the report. Staff of the funding clinic advised on the device-fitting protocol. The authors declare no conflict of interest. Recorded as not independent of the manufacturer because of this funding link; the link does not establish that the manufacturer controlled the research.

after.change: independent: true → false; conflict-of-interest and result wording corrected (academic-led, part-funded through a grant made in partnership with the manufacturer).
